message.content: {"basis": "The Region R pie chart legend binds the light-gray slice to Public Transit and the red slice to Car. The printed slice shares are Public Transit 58% and Car 42%. The routing criterion is the majority-share transport mode, and 58% exceeds 50%, so Public Transit is the majority-share mode. This maps to the option to route Public Transit to majority-preference policy follow-up.", "option_label": "Route Public Transit to majority-preference policy follow-up"}
